structured_deals.economic_effect: Four 50MW IT tranches, $9.6668B maximum service fees over an average five-year term and $1.9328B scheduled upfront payments. Upfront cash is credited after month 24 and bears no interest. Billing begins only upon acceptance of minimum GPU quantity. The firm minimum commitment is subject to delivery, delay, termination and service provisions; contract value is not current revenue or physical utilization.

The Microsoft deployment carries an approximately $5.8B Dell purchase; a later Blackwell order for a separate managed-services deployment is approximately $1.6B. IREN parent unconditionally guarantees the applicable purchasing subsidiaries' Dell obligations. Supplier hardware cash obligations therefore remain parent-supported even when customer/project financing is ring-fenced.

$3.645B senior secured GPU financing comprises a $1.545B DDTL at one-month SOFR plus 2.25% and $2.1B notes at 5.96%, amortizing through 2031. It is collateralized by the Microsoft GPUs, SPV equity and contract cash flows. Sizing requires at least 1.20x projected DSCR and ongoing quarterly DSCR is at least 1.05x. General recourse is limited, but the parent guarantees hedge obligations, a post-termination/failed-remarketing shortfall until tranche release, and managed-services performance. The SPV is a consolidated VIE.

Five-year $3.4B managed-services contract for NVIDIA internal workloads is planned within 60MW of existing Childress data centers. The 60MW boundary is not labeled IT, so no per-IT-MW result is calculated. The associated $1.6B Dell order includes GPUs, servers, storage, networking and services; no FY2026 revenue is attributed to this future deployment. Attribution reconciliation: May7 release and 10-K name NVIDIA; May26 Dell exhibit does not. The Dell purchasing guarantee is IREN parent, not a NVIDIA debt guarantee.

Recent customer prepayments are 45-55% of associated GPU capex. $3.6B Microsoft financing plus prepayments funds 96% of associated GPU capex. A separate $2.4B Mackenzie financing bears 9.0% fixed interest and funds 90% of associated GPU capex; with customer prepayments, funding exceeds GPU capex and can support some data-center capex. This does not eliminate FY2027 funding risk: management forecasts $25-30B capex, identifies $14B existing cash/committed funding and targets another approximately $8B, leaving a residual for data-center financing, operating cash flow, corporate debt or equity.

Financing requires power-consumption hedges and interest-rate protection (CTA Sections5.23–5.24); company reports compliance June30. Do not infer an all-in fixed site electricity bill. Matched volumes, basis/congestion and delivery costs remain necessary for power economics.

The 2GW Sweetwater hub is conditionally included in ERCOT Batch Zero as base load, but only 300MW gross at Sweetwater 1 is under construction for a Q4 2027 target. Conditional portfolio/grid capacity is excluded from current and period-average AI IT denominators.

structured_deals.status: Executed contingent remedy; no default or loss asserted
structured_deals.economic_effect: After valid non-acceptance termination, a normally 60-day remarketing window (conditional extension to120) permits sale, future-tranche reallocation or qualified replacement. Sale proceeds pay tranche debt first, then customer upfront refund. Parent guarantee can cover residual debt/refund subject to triggers, exceptions and tranche release. Schedule1.1(a) limits automatic replacement to Amazon, Meta, Alphabet, NVIDIA or their guaranteed obligors, with remaining-tenor, DSCR and rating conditions; lenders may approve alternatives. Falling resale value can therefore translate into parent cash exposure without weak end demand.

revenue_engine.seller: IREN owns/finances GPU clusters and supporting data centers and supplies bare metal or managed AI Cloud capacity.
revenue_engine.buyers: Microsoft; NVIDIA confirmed by May7 release and FY26 10-K; other AI developers and undisclosed frontier lab.
revenue_engine.billable_unit: Reserved GPU compute services, commonly GPU/hour pricing with contract term, tranche quantity and acceptance requirements. Public Microsoft GPU/hour price and minimum count are redacted. Storage and ancillaries may be separately billed.
revenue_engine.recognition: ASC606 services recognized as obligations satisfied; dedicated identified GPU/space arrangements with predominant lease component under ASC842 commence at acceptance. No customer operating lease revenue in FY26. Prepayments recorded as liabilities until recognition criteria met.
revenue_engine.utilization: Reserved-capacity fee protection is distinct from actual workload utilization. Delivery delay, SLA credits, suspension and valid termination can reduce or defer cash. Do not infer full physical utilization from contracted ARR.

capital_and_collateral.limits: Stocks have different boundaries and are not additive into an idle GPU total. SPV payables cannot identify settled GPU invoices. Net book value is not current realizable collateral value. Guarantees expire differently; accepted Horizon1 is not subject to the same pre-acceptance remarketing guarantee as remaining tranches.
capital_and_collateral.economic_loss_formula: For an eligible terminated tranche, conditional parent exposure includes required debt/redemption amount less applied sale proceeds, plus contractually due upfront refund; apply contractual limits, exclusions and actual cash waterfall. No quantified exposure without tranche debt, refund and market appraisal.
